national.note: Partial. The tables on that page carry 39 birds and 14 mammals; the third edition of the book (Știința, 2015) lists 62 birds and 30 mammals. Everything here is therefore an under-count of the national list, never an over-count. Replace with the official annex when it is available.

names.what: French vernacular label (rdfs:label @fr) and a class check for every scientific name in scripts/sources/redbook-md.json, matched on taxon name (P225).
names.note: The class check (Aves Q5113 / Mammalia Q7377) is kept from the other Wikidata snapshot for the same reason: a bare name match is not a taxon match. Two entries in the transcription carry a spelling variant — 'Aquila chrysaetus' and 'Mustela eversmanni' — and the accepted spelling that matched is recorded as `accepted`. Mustela eversmanii has no French vernacular label on Wikidata, so it is left null and the chapter shows the scientific name.

global.what: taxon name (P225) and IUCN Red List category (P141) for every vernacular name in the two surveys, plus a class check that the matched taxon sits under Aves (Q5113) or Mammalia (Q7377).
global.note: The class check is not decoration: matching by French vernacular name alone put 'Renard' on Alopias vulpinus, the thresher shark, which is called renard de mer in French. That match is dropped here.
